chen_case.definition: Mean(conditional payroll analysis/known-error correction/source-payroll bridge; maternity/HRIS correction; receipt/trigger/funding reconciliation; three September-return nursing protection abilities).

he_historical_period.definition: Full signed-adjustment-period analysis .5 + correct source binding .25 + accountable historical actual-task query .25.

he_other_protection.definition: Mean(task/version conflict, original prior-confirmation query, current-stage proof review, currently safe job controls, ordinary-expiry hold).

wang_contract.definition: Conditional source-bound expiry/ineffective-draft hold and continuation analysis.

wang_current_nursing.definition: Actual current nursing arrangement and correction/verification of inappropriate existing schedule fields, with an accountable path. Future prevention alone is not a substitute.

zhao_current.definition: Mean(actual-night source analysis, payroll correction/true deduction-period link, current protective controls).

zhao_historical_use.definition: Mean of six independent binary abilities: actual-use evidence boundary and accountable historical inquiry for each May18-22,July14,Aug8 episode. Whole-period mapped inquiries can cover multiple episodes.

zhou_current.definition: Mean(actual-night source analysis, payroll correction/performance review, protection control, actual event correction).

settlement.binary: All seven independently evaluated minimum-usable current-business predicates pass. No strict threshold.

partial_credit: Complementary abilities retain their means. Basic source-analysis units use adopted analysis*(.5+.25 source binding+.25 accountable action). An actual current clinical evidence plan itself establishes current-proof adoption. No lexical adoption gate.
damage_ownership: Repeated same-cause renderings are one event. Adopted known-record blocking and same-final-output timing conflicts have exclusive error ownership, with only their corresponding correctness atom conditionally credited. Independent missing inquiries remain missing. Conservative nonblocking calendar/clinical/source details have .02 utility debit; actual blocking execution/rights errors .6.
